# Gray Commercial Tire and Auto

> Local commercial and passenger tire shop and full-service automotive repair facility located at 121 Homer Roberts Rd, Gray, GA 31032, serving drivers, pickups, and commercial fleets across Gray, Jones County, Macon, and Milledgeville, Georgia.

## Verified Business Facts

- **Business Name:** Gray Commercial Tire and Auto
- **Street Address:** 121 Homer Roberts Rd, Gray, GA 31032
- **Main Phone:** (478) 936-0014
- **Hours:** Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM ET (Closed Saturday and Sunday)
- **Service Area:** Gray, Jones County, Macon, and Milledgeville, GA (Middle Georgia)

## Core Services

### Tires and Wheels
- Commercial tires and wheels (work trucks, vans, and fleet vehicles)
- Passenger tires and wheels (cars, crossovers, SUVs, and light trucks)
- Tire balancing
- Tire rotation

### Automotive Maintenance & Mechanical Repair
- Oil changes
- Brake service and repair
- Front end repair
- Vehicle diagnostics
- Wheel alignments
- Suspension service
- General mechanical repair

### Truck Upgrades
- Lift and leveling kits
- Bumpers

### Roadside Assistance
- Roadside service for vehicles needing tire or mechanical assistance away from the shop
